title: KAN-93: Name both dates when a date range is reversed
description: NewDayRange now names both dates when a range ends before it starts, with a test. Also gives Oura 30 seconds rather than 15 to answer a read.

story.summary: Name both dates when a date range is reversed
story.description:
**As** the developer of the Oura MCP server,

**I want** the error for a reversed date range to name both dates,

**So that** a bad request to get_sleep_summary can be fixed from its error alone.

## Scope

- Name both dates in the error for a reversed range.

## Acceptance criteria

**Given** a date range whose last day is before its first day
**When** NewDayRange is called
**Then** it returns an error that names both dates and still matches the reversed-range error with errors.Is
